description: A Norwegian Positive Energy Neighborhood Dataset of Electrical Measurements and Interviews on Energy Practices (NorPEN) is a data set described in the paper "A Norwegian Positive Energy Neighborhood Dataset of Electrical Measurements and Interviews on Energy Practices (NorPEN)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2024), produced by Apostolos Vavouris, Fernanda Guasselli, Lina Stankovic and colleagues. Emerging concepts for sustainable urban development, such as positive energy districts/neighborhoods (PEDs/PENs), are being implemented in Europe in light of the goal of net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. From the building to the district/neighborhood scales, these projects are supporting the implementation of local renewable energy sources (RES), encouraging the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) and smart home technologies (SHTs). Coverage: a Norwegian positive energy neighbourhood. The data are held on University of Strathclyde, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support neighbourhood energy demand and flexibility studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
